messages:
ara: Filed a small docs-refresh PR for the onboarding quickstart. Goal: consolidate the hello-world auth bits into a single page, add a short service-account flow, and include a tiny Docker snippet for private deployments. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5478

drew: Thanks! Can we also add a tiny troubleshooting section for '403' from KMS? Seen a few customers hit that during onboarding.

shilpa: yes — suggest two bullets: 1) ensure SA has kms.decrypt and storage.objects.get on the secret path, 2) check that the orchestration mounts /run/secrets correctly. Keep it terse.

ara: good call. i'll add a 2-line troubleshooting block and a link to the KMS guide. Also adding a note about not checking secrets into git.

docs-bot: PR 5478 1 docs lint warnings (style: prefer backticks for inline code).

ci-bot: Preview ready: https://deploy-preview-5478--redwood-docs.netlify.app/onboard-hello (expires in 7 days)

drew: For the Docker snippet  can we bind to 127.0.0.1 by default in examples and mention switching to 0.0.0.0 for dev? some customers copy/paste into docker run -p without noticing.

shilpa: also add a one-liner about limiting container image size: use slim base images and pin deps. don't expand into a full ops guide.

ara: implemented both suggestions and added a single line showing how to mount the SA as a secret: 
```bash
docker run --rm -v /path/to/sa:/run/secrets/redwood_sa:ro -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 my-hello-image
```

tom: quick nit: change "service account" -> "service-account" in headings for consistency with other docs.

ara: fixed. also swapped the env-var example to show reading from /run/secrets in Python, per security team guidance.

docs-bot: spellcheck passes. broken links: 0.

ci-bot: docs build passed. staging link: https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/onboard-hello

drew: i'm happy to give a final editorial pass. nothing functional left. Can we aim to merge before end of day so new hires see the updated flow?

shilpa: sounds good. if all OK i'll squash and merge after drew's signoff.

ara: thanks everyone 1 I'll add a short changelog blurb and a shipnote for the onboarding cadence.
